empty-sheet-placeholder.title: This is an empty event sheet
empty-sheet-placeholder.add-paragraph: To start adding events, click [b]Add event[/b] in the top-left corner of this view. You can also double-click or double-tap in a space. Alternatively you can bring up a menu by right-click or tap-and-hold or clicking the [b]Add...[/b] link in the top-right.
empty-sheet-placeholder.desc-paragraph: Events are run from top-to-bottom once per tick (i.e. at the framerate), typically 60 times a second. An example event is shown below. The [i]conditions[/i] are on the left and the [i]actions[/i] are on the right. The actions only run when the conditions are met. The margin can be used to select or modify the whole event. For more information see [a1]How events work[/a1].

empty-flowchart.title: This is an empty flowchart
empty-flowchart.blurb-1: To start adding nodes, you can bring up a menu by right-click or tap-and-hold and choosing one of the available options. After creating nodes you can add more information to them and connect them by clicking and dragging from an [b]Output[/b] into an [b]Input[/b] in a different node.
empty-flowchart.blurb-2: Use [b]Flowcharts[/b] to arrange information in a tree like structure and establish logical connections between each node. Use the [b]Flowchart Controller[/b] to setup events to navigate through and query the tree for information at runtime.
